test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If interest is being compound annually, then what sum will amount to Rs. 4036.8 in 2 years at the rate of 16 percent per annum at compound interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Future amount (A) = Rs. 4,036.80

Annual interest rate (r) = 16% or 0.16

Number of times interest is compounded per year (n) = 1 (compounded annually)

Time period (t) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

A = P(1 + r/n)⁽ⁿt⁾

**Calculation:**

4,036.80 = P(1 + 0.16/1)⁽ ¹ × ²⁾

(1.16)² =1.3456

P = 4,036.80/1.3456

P = Rs. 3,000

**The principal amount is approximately Rs. 3,000.**
